en.title: Cartier, form in motion
en.summary: At Cartier, design precedes mechanical engineering, with artistic conception driving watchmaking creation from the La Chaux-de-Fonds Manufacture through 2026 designs, reversing the traditional industry approach where movement specifications determine case design.

stories.title: Neue Nachtzug-Verbindung – Im 70 Jahre alten Zug von Aarau nach Brüssel

en.title: New night train connection – From Aarau to Brussels in a 70-year-old train
en.summary: A new night train service has been established as such trains gain importance in climate discussions. The offering uses a seventy-year-old train for the route.

stories.title: Des avions de chasse de l'Otan ont abattu un drone au-dessus de la Lituanie

en.title: NATO fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania
en.summary: NATO forces shot down a drone over Lithuania, according to the country's president. Poland's military also reported conducting aerial operations due to Russian drone strikes targeting Ukraine.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Häusliche Gewalt hat viel mit der Herkunft zu tun – es wird Zeit, dass die Behörden das Offensichtliche beim Namen nennen

en.title: COMMENTARY - Domestic violence is closely linked to origin – it's time authorities name the obvious
en.summary: The commentary argues that foreign men commit domestic violence against spouses and children at higher rates than Swiss nationals, and contends that acknowledging this fact is necessary for addressing the problem.

stories.title: La Cour suprême refuse à Donald Trump de restreindre le vote par correspondance

en.title: Supreme Court refuses to allow Donald Trump to restrict mail-in voting
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a request to implement a Trump administration measure aimed at restricting mail-in voting for the November midterm elections.

stories.title: La Cour suprême inflige un revers à Donald Trump sur le vote par correspondance

en.title: Supreme Court deals setback to Donald Trump on mail-in voting
en.summary: The conservative-majority Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's attempt to implement stricter mail-in voting rules before November's midterm elections, finding the government unlikely to prevail on the merits.

stories.title: Un juge américain suspend les futures limites de visa pour étudiants et journalistes étrangers

en.title: American judge suspends future visa limits for foreign students and journalists
en.summary: A federal judge has indefinitely postponed new restrictions on stays in the United States for foreign students and journalists, expressing skepticism about the Trump administration's arguments.

stories.title: Le rappeur américain Macklemore banni de la tournée d'Ed Sheeran pour son soutien de la Palestine

en.title: American rapper Macklemore banned from Ed Sheeran's tour for his support of Palestine
en.summary: Rapper Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour due to pro-Palestinian statements he made during previous concerts.

stories.title: Aux Etats-Unis, un juge suspend l'entrée en vigueur des limites de visa pour étudiants et journalistes étrangers

en.title: US judge suspends implementation of visa limits for foreign students and journalists
en.summary: A federal judge in Boston has temporarily blocked new restrictions on visa duration for foreign students and journalists announced by the Trump administration, finding the government failed to demonstrate how the rules address national security concerns.

stories.title: Le Contrôle des finances épingle le projet fédéral d'aménagement du rail et de la route

en.title: Federal Finance Control criticizes government's rail and road infrastructure project
en.summary: Switzerland's federal financial oversight body has challenged the Transports'45 project, citing insufficient decision-making bases, overestimated profitability, and uncertain financing for the federal government's rail, road, and urban traffic development plan.

stories.title: Transports’45: le Contrôle fédéral des finances étrille la méthode d’Albert Rösti

en.title: Transports'45: Federal Finance Control criticizes Albert Rösti's method
en.summary: A federal oversight body released a critical report on the government's approach to prioritizing transportation investments through 2045, citing methodological flaws and overstated projections.

stories.title: Kulturnews in Kurzform – «Free Palestine»-Rufe: Macklemore von Sheeran-Tour ausgeschlossen

en.title: Culture news in brief – "Free Palestine" chants: Macklemore excluded from Sheeran tour
en.summary: US rapper Macklemore has been removed from Ed Sheeran's tour following a petition prompted by his critical statements about Israel.

stories.title: INTERAKTIV - «Die Marktschreier rufen die globale Krise aus – und dann passiert nichts», sagt der Präsident des Private-Equity-Riesen Blackstone

en.title: INTERACTIVE - "Market commentators declare global crisis and then nothing happens," says Blackstone CEO
en.summary: Jonathan Gray, president of private equity giant Blackstone, dismisses fears of an artificial intelligence bubble as unfounded while addressing concerns among retail investors amid market volatility.

stories.title: Die Schweiz gerät wegen der OECD-Mindeststeuer ins Hintertreffen. Zwei Professoren wollen Abhilfe schaffen

en.title: Switzerland falls behind due to OECD minimum tax. Two professors want to provide a remedy
en.summary: Switzerland has become less tax-attractive for large corporations, particularly since the USA withdrew from the OECD minimum tax agreement. A new expert report suggests potential countermeasures to address this disadvantage.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Die Inflation wird für die Republikaner zu einem immer grösseren Problem

en.title: COMMENT - Inflation becomes an increasingly major problem for Republicans
en.summary: Donald Trump has stated that the USA would accept higher gasoline prices to achieve victory against Iran. While this position may be consistent, it could cost his party the majority in midterm elections.

stories.title: Mohammed bin Salmans jemenitischer Albtraum: Der Huthi-Vormarsch schockt Saudiarabien

en.title: Mohammed bin Salman's Yemeni nightmare: The Houthi advance shocks Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Houthis' capture of the Bab al-Mandab strait has severely restricted Saudi Arabia's oil exports. The crown prince now faces limited options for responding to this development.

stories.title: KI könnte zu gefährlich werden für die Menschheit, fürchten die Chefs der Techfirmen. Doch lässt sich KI überhaupt regulieren?

en.title: AI could become too dangerous for humanity, fear tech company executives. But can AI even be regulated?
en.summary: American AI companies are seeking to slow technological development, while President Trump opposes such measures. The question remains whether effective AI regulation is feasible.
